snippet.title: Drop Jump - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370410

Drop Jump is a high-octane arcade platformer where precision meets creativity. While the core game tests your skill through intense, rhythm-synced levels, the true heart of the game lies in its unlimited replayability driven by the community.

Key Features:

Powerful Level Editor: Build your own gauntlets using an intuitive, full-featured editor. Place obstacles, sync them to the beat, and design your ultimate challenge.

Share & Compete: Upload your custom levels to the global workshop. Challenge the community to beat your creations and see where you rank.

Infinite Content: Browse and download thousands of levels created by other players. There is always a new challenge waiting for you.

Rhythm-Sync Action: Every jump and obstacle is tied to the soundtrack, helping you find the perfect flow.

Total Customization: Unlock unique icons and colors to personalize your character.

Practice Mode: Master difficult sections with checkpoints before attempting a perfect run.
